text.p: Results of English Sunday League cricket matches:
At Derby: Derbyshire beat Warwickshire by eight wickets. Warwickshire 156-9 innings closed, Derbyshire 160-2 (K.Barnett 57 not out)
At Chelmsford: Essex beat Sussex by seven wickets. Sussex 215-8 innings closed (P.Moores 55), Essex 217-3 (S.Law 120, N.Hussain 71)
At Northampton: Lancashire beat Northamptonshire by seven wickets. Northamptonshire 202-5 innings closed (A.Penberthy 80, R.Bailey 57 not out), Lancashire 203-3 (J.Gallian 70, P.McKeown 69).
At Chester-le-Street: Leicestershire beat Durham by 130 runs. Leicestershire 344-4 innings closed (P.Simmons 115, D.Maddy 106 not out, A.Habib 50 not out), Durham 214-3 (S.Hutton 81, D.Ligertwood 54)
At Scarborough: Nottinghamshire beat Yorkshire by 24 runs. Nottinghamshire 251-5 innings closed (P.Johnson 52, T.Robinson 51), Yorkshire 227 (C.Cairns 5-41)
At Cardiff: Surrey beat Glamorgan by seven wickets. Glamorgan 159-9 innings closed, Surrey 161-3.
At Uxbridge: Middlesex beat Somerset by four wickets. Somerset 194 (G.Rose 54), Middlesex 195-6 (M.Ramprakash 80 not out)
At Canterbury: Kent beat Hampshire by one run. Kent 172 (C.Hooper 70, T.Ward 51), Hampshire 171-4 (J.Laney 57, G.White 56)
At Worcester: Worcestershire beat Gloucestershire by 14 runs. Worcestershire 257-2 innings closed (T.Moody 102, T.Curtis 77, G.Hick 57 not out), Gloucestershire 243-7 innings closed (R.Dawson 85)
